attchmntText: TVS Electronics Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Change in Director(s) of the company.
voiceSummary: TVS Electronics Limited appointed Mr. Narayan Keelveedhi Seshadri, DIN 00053563, as an Additional Director in the category of Non-Executive Non-Independent Director with effect from 14th November 2026. The appointment is for a period of five consecutive years, from 14th November 2026 to 13th November 2031, liable to retire by rotation. This appointment is subject to the approval of shareholders of the Company. Mr. Seshadri is not debarred from holding the office of Director by any order passed by the Securities and Exchange Board of India or any other authority. He is not related to any of the Directors or Key Managerial Personnel of the Company.

attchmntText: Board Meeting Outcome - Unaudited Financial Results- Q2-2026-27
voiceSummary: TVS Electronics Limited approved unaudited financial results for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. The company reported a net loss of 141 Lakhs, compared to a net profit of 155 Lakhs in the same period last year. Total income from operations was 11,616 Lakhs. The Board appointed Mr. Narayan Keelveedhi Seshadri, DIN 00053563, as an Additional Director, Non-Executive Non-Independent Director, effective 14th November 2026. His appointment is for five years, subject to shareholder approval. The appointment is liable to retire by rotation. The meeting concluded at 5.20 p.m. on 14th November 2026.

TVS Electronics Limited has announced an earnings conference call scheduled for Monday, November 16, 2026, at 4 P.M. IST. The call will discuss the company's earnings for Q2 and H1 of FY27. Management representatives Mrs. Srilalitha Gopal, Managing Director, and Mr. A K Velu, Chief Financial Officer, will participate. The event is accessible via universal dial-in numbers plus 91 22 6280 1341 and plus 91 22 7115 8242. International toll-free numbers are available for the USA, UK, Singapore, and Hong Kong. A Diamond Pass link and an investor kit link are provided for access.

attchmntText: Significant increase in volume has been observed in TVS Electronics Limited. The Exchange, in order to ensure that investors have latest relevant information about the company and to inform the market place so that the interest of the investors is safeguarded, had written to the company. TVS Electronics Limited has submitted their response.
voiceSummary: TVS Electronics Limited responded to National Stock Exchange of India Limited regarding a clarification on significant increase in volume. The company stated it has informed all events and information bearing on the operation or performance of the Company. This includes all price sensitive information as and when required. The company confirmed there is no pending information to be intimated under Regulation 30 of SEBI LODR Regulations 2015. The response was signed by K Santosh, Company Secretary.
